title: Robotaxis around Salesforce Tower (experimental)
site: SoMa, San Francisco: the blocks around Salesforce Tower
notes: Experimental scene. Streets are real (OpenStreetMap); vehicle motion is simulated and the camera frames are synthetic (Cosmos-Predict2.5). Every model call is real. Hazard events carry a map cell (a street block): fleet memory reuses an Ultra decision for that block instead of calling Ultra again, never for events with people.

events.text: Robotaxi with one passenger heading to the Ferry Building. Lane clear, green light, light traffic. Lidar and radar show no obstruction.

events.where: Fremont St between Mission and Howard
events.text: Empty, en route to a pickup at 1st and Howard. Forward camera shows a vehicle stopped in the right lane ahead with hazard lights; lidar confirms a large static object. Planned route continues down this block.
Passed AV14 at the intersection; received the hazard precedent for the Fremont block.
Passed AV09; received the hazard precedent for the Fremont block (hop 2).
Approaching the crosswalk to turn right; forward camera shows activity at the curb ahead.

events.where: Fremont St between Mission and Howard (second robotaxi)
events.text: Two passengers, heading to Folsom St. Planned route enters the Fremont block. Forward camera shows a vehicle stopped in the right lane ahead with hazard lights; lidar confirms a large static object.

events.where: Fremont St between Mission and Howard (later)
events.text: Empty, repositioning to the Transit Center. Approaching the Fremont block. Camera frame attached.
